parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: OperateTaskId
parameters.description:
The task ID that is generated by the handling operation.

>  You can call the [OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~) operation to handle alerts. You can obtain the task ID from the response parameters.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-virus-scan-machine-event --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --uuid a6931624-c43e-4323-9128-a6be6ffdxxxx --operate-task-id 233886xx --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
